cond_0001.intro:
The IR Next Program will provide recent college graduates with challenging assignments in a variety of finance functional areas, leadership training and valuable exposure to our businesses and senior leaders. Through functional rotations and experiences in multiple business locations, selected candidates will be able to build diverse skill sets and a strong foundation for a successful career with [Company name masked].
These assignments and specialized development curriculum are designed to ensure continuous learning and development. The 24-month rotational program offers candidates who have recently obtained their Bachelor's Degree in Accounting/Finance (or other related field) exposure to a variety of assignments which could include: Cost Accounting, Inventory Management, Budgeting and Planning, Commercial Finance, Financial Analysis, Internal Controls, Compliance and Project Management, and Treasury.
The objective of the IR Next program is to develop and grow the participant's financial and business acumen as well as the leadership skills necessary to prepare them for a role in the Finance organization upon successful completion of the program.
cond_0001.requirements:
We are looking for performance-driven, innovative leaders who understand the importance of collaboration and customer focus.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field completed between May 2023 and June 2024, or 5th year Master's Degree in Accounting or Finance, to be completed between December 2023 and June 2024
Related majors include: Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Math, or Operations
Have completed, or plan to complete, accounting courses up to and including Intermediate Accounting (or college/university equivalent)
Leadership experience in an extra-curricular activity or organization
Sponsorship for work visas are not available for this program
Preferred Requirements
Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above
Previous Finance Co-Op/Internship or other practical experience in the manufacturing industry
Must be willing to relocate to any [Company name masked] location, up to two times, over the duration of the program
Key Competencies
Exceptional organization, communication (verbal and written), and follow-up skills with the ability to effectively manage priorities and commitments
Strong interpersonal skills, able to follow standard processes and work autonomously while understanding when to escalate issues that require further review
Utilize financial data to diagnose business strengths and weaknesses as well as the implications for potential strategies
Collaborate with others to foster effective teamwork by linking own responsibilities to the team's goals and needs - zeal for new information, knowledge, and experiences
Ability to learn quickly and embrace change
Self-starters who are results-oriented, analytical, innovative, intellectually curious and who take initiative and risks

cond_0071.intro:
The IR Next Program gives recent college graduates challenging assignments across a variety of finance functional areas, leadership training, and direct exposure to senior leaders. Through functional rotations and experiences across multiple business locations, selected candidates will build diverse skill sets and a strong foundation for a career in finance.
These assignments and a specialized development curriculum are designed to drive the candidate's continuous learning and growth. The 24-month rotational program is open to candidates who have recently completed a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting/Finance or a related field. Rotations may cover: Cost Accounting, Inventory Management, Budgeting and Planning, Commercial Finance, Financial Analysis, Internal Controls, Compliance and Project Management, and Treasury.
The goal of the IR Next program is to develop each participant's financial and business acumen and the leadership skills needed to take on a role in the Finance organization upon completing the program.

Through functional rotations and experiences in multiple business locations, selected candidates will be able to build diverse skill sets and a strong foundation for a successful and fulfilling career with [Company name masked].
These assignments and specialized development curriculum are strategically designed to ensure the candidate's continuous learning and development. [Company name masked]'s 24-month rotational program offers candidates who have recently obtained their Bachelor's Degree in Accounting/Finance (or other related field) exposure to a variety of assignments which could include: Cost Accounting, Inventory Management, Budgeting and Planning, Commercial Finance, Financial Analysis, Internal Controls, Compliance and Project Management, and Treasury.
The objective of the IR Next program is to develop and grow the participant's financial and business acumen as well as the leadership skills necessary to prepare them for a role in the Finance organization upon successful completion of the program.
cond_0254.requirements:
We are looking for performance-driven, innovative leaders who understand the importance of collaboration and customer focus.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (including Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Math, or Operations) completed between May 2023 and June 2024; or 5th year Master's Degree in Accounting or Finance completed between December 2023 and June 2024
Demonstrated completion of, or firm plan to complete, accounting courses through Intermediate Accounting (or college/university equivalent)
Demonstrated leadership experience in an extra-curricular activity or organization
Available for the full duration of the program
Sponsorship for work visas is not available for this program
Preferred Requirements
Proven GPA of 3.0 or above
Substantial prior Finance Co-Op, internship, or other practical experience in the manufacturing industry

Exceptional organization, communication (verbal and written), and follow-up skills with the ability to effectively manage priorities and commitments
Strong interpersonal skills, able to follow standard processes and work autonomously while understanding when to escalate issues that require further review
Utilize financial data to diagnose business strengths and weaknesses as well as the implications for potential strategies
Collaborate with others to foster effective teamwork by linking own responsibilities to the team's goals and needs - zeal for new information, knowledge, and experiences

Through rotations across multiple business locations, participants build diverse skills and a solid foundation for a career in finance.
Assignments and a structured development curriculum are designed to support continuous learning. The 24-month program is open to candidates who have recently completed a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance (or a related field). Rotations may cover areas such as Cost Accounting, Inventory Management, Budgeting and Planning, Commercial Finance, Financial Analysis, Internal Controls, Compliance and Project Management, and Treasury.
The goal of the program is to help participants grow their financial and business knowledge, as well as the leadership skills needed to move into a role within the Finance organization after completing the program.
cond_0360.responsibilities:
Participants will work alongside colleagues across finance functional areas, contributing to assignments and sharing in the team's goals throughout each rotation.
Coordinate with team members to support financial analysis and help diagnose business strengths and areas for improvement
Work alongside finance and business partners to assist with budgeting, planning, and reporting activities
Collaborate on projects related to cost accounting, inventory management, internal controls, compliance, and treasury
Share updates and keep relevant stakeholders informed on project progress and findings
Support cross-functional teams by helping ensure alignment on priorities and commitments
Contribute to team efforts by linking your work to broader team goals and helping others where needed
Participate in the program's leadership development curriculum alongside fellow program participants
cond_0360.requirements:
We are looking for performance-driven, innovative leaders who understand the importance of collaboration and customer focus.
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field completed between May 2023 and June 2024, or 5th year Master's Degree in Accounting or Finance, to be completed between December 2023 and June 2024
Related majors include: Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Math, or Operations
Have completed, or plan to complete, accounting courses up to and including Intermediate Accounting (or college/university equivalent)
Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above
Previous Finance Co-Op/Internship or other practical experience in the manufacturing industry preferred
Leadership experience in an extra-curricular activity or organization
Available for duration of the program (24 months) with a tentative start date of August 2024
Sponsorship for work visas are not available for this program
Must be willing to relocate to any [Company name masked] location, up to two times, over the duration of the program
Exceptional organization, communication (verbal and written), and follow-up skills with the ability to effectively manage priorities and commitments
Strong interpersonal skills, able to follow standard processes and work autonomously while understanding when to escalate issues that require further review
Ability to utilize financial data to diagnose business strengths and weaknesses as well as the implications for potential strategies
Collaborative approach to teamwork, linking own responsibilities to the team's goals and needs, with a zeal for new information, knowledge, and experiences
Ability to learn quickly and embrace change
Results-oriented, analytical, innovative, intellectually curious, and willing to take initiative

cond_0439.intro:
We are looking for a Finance Rotational Program candidate to join our team.
The IR Next Program provides recent college graduates with challenging assignments across a variety of finance functional areas, along with leadership training and exposure to multiple areas of the business. Through functional rotations at multiple business locations, selected candidates will build diverse skill sets and a solid foundation for a career in finance.
Assignments and a structured development curriculum are designed to support continuous learning.
